notes.title: Patch 0.19 - Combat Log, Fight Preview, Difficulty & More!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 0.19 - Combat log, Fight Preview, Difficulty & more![/h1]
It's been almost two months since the last update and for good reason.
The update is beefy and packed with a ton of systems that touch almost every part of the game.
Since there's a lot of things that go together, we wanted to ship it all in one update, rather than split it up.

Sorry for the wait, but we hope you think it's worth it!

[b]In this update, we have focused on the following:[/b][list]	[*]Added a Combat Log to fights. You can view it inside or outside of combat.[/*]	[*]Fight Previews are live. You will now get a short preview of some important things to consider for each fight.[/*]	[*]Path changes are live. Enemies are now at the end of each map, and another mini-boss has been added halfway through.[/*]	[*]Base difficulty greatly adjusted. Game is much harder and now has three modes (Normal, Hard, Insane).[/*]	[*]Items have been overhauled. Items now have tiers, and you get higher tier items as you progress.[/*]	[*]First performance update pushed, with some much-needed improvements. Let us know if it helps![/*][/list]Right now the game changes constantly and rapidly. We're experimenting and figuring out what works.
If you want to help build an awesome game, please join our small community on discord! 

We are always looking for more testers, building an indie game with a small team is hard.
[b]Join our Discord[/b] server here: [url=https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA]https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA[/url][h2]Patch Notes 0.19:[/h2][b]--- COMBAT LOG: ---[/b]
Finally! It's a huge system and touches almost all cards and mechanics.
It will be improved over time, but first iteration should be up and running.
Let us know if some information is missing, or it's visually confusing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/10912719daab556abd691fd2334a82d40e064170.png[/img]

[b]--- FIGHT PREVIEW: ---[/b]
Fights now preview both encounters next to each other, and display relevant information before going in.
They won't tell you everything, but you shouldn't feel like you're going in blind anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/03647b08c1ab932f39d8bf52543792e4bbb2619c.png[/img]

[b]--- DIFFICULTY: --- [/b]
We significantly increased baseline difficulty, and the new baseline is called "normal".
Once you beat normal, you unlock Hardmode, and if you beat that, you unlock Insane.
We expect these to change and get tweaked as we go, but they are a good indicator for now.
Play at the level you're most comfortable at, and tell us how it feels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/6000733f0a9e1b6499bbf2e98e99bf3e45b7abee.png[/img]

[b]--- PATHING UPDATE: --- [/b]
Combats are now at the end of each map, this is to give you a better idea of what's to come after rewards.
In addition, if you lose a combat (any combat) you are now teleported back to the start of that map, allowing you to collect another set of rewards before the rematch.
There is now an additional boss-encounter halfway through a chapter. This will always be the same Hero as you are currently controlling, giving you a real halfway test.

[b]--- ITEM OVERHAUL: --- [/b]
Item system has been overhauled. Now there exists 6 tiers of items (0-5), and you will get higher tiers of items after each boss.

[b]--- PERFORMANCE: ---[/b]
We added a ton of performance improvements, especially to the battle scene.
In addition, there is now some basic performance settings in the menu, let us know if it helps or if you're still experiencing issues.

[b]--- CONTENT: ---[/b]
Added 10 new cards, most of them to Rogue.
Added 15 new items, spread across the new Tiers. Reworked a lot of the old ones.
Added two brand new mechanics:
- Lock: When a locked card would activate, instead skip it and count down the lock.
- Furor: After using a damage-card attack an aditional time for 3 damage, then -1 Furor.

[b]--- BALANCE: ---[/b]
A ton of cards have been rebalanced.
Generally scaling has been reduced a bit. We're also reeling in the stats and percentage-based bonuses in general.
Stacking percentages have a way of getting out of hand too quickly, so we're reducing those across the board.
In addition, many Rogue Cards have been buffed, as she was underperforming slightly.

That's it for this time!
See you in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: Patch 0.18 - New Hero, New Enemies, New Shop!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 0.18 - New Character, New Enemies, New Shop[/h1]Eman the Rogue joins the battle! A brand new character, with new cards, some new elements and some old ones!

This patch is focused around building up the 3-character dynamic, now allowing for different teams to be built each run.
It also revampes the main way you gain cards, including a rework to the copper-economy and enabling more player agency.

[b]In this update, we have focused on the following:[/b][list]	[*]3rd Character Eman, is now available for play once you have beaten her.[/*]	[*]New enemies have been added to the map & some old ones slightly reworked[/*]	[*]All bosses have been reworked and rebalanced. Now have realistic builds and are much more challenging.[/*]	[*]Adjusted base difficulty slightly up, while offering more player choice and power to compensate.[/*]	[*]Shop has been reworked to show more cards, and now every map has a shop at the end.[/*]	[*]Card upgrade system reworked, and now go way higher![/*][/list]We push regular updates every 2-3 weeks with major stuff each time. 
If you want to help build an awesome game, please join our small community on discord! 

We are always looking for more testers, building an indie game with a small team is hard!
[b]Join our Discord[/b] here: [url=https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA]https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA[/url]

[h2]Patch Notes 0.18:[/h2][b]--- Eman the Rogue: ---[/b]
Fully implemented as playable character.
Currently has 40 brand new cards.
New items and new elements added to her.
Unlock by beating her with one of the other characters.
Now many different team combinations are available between the three!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/1411ad1b2698ca1e9d987226f684677c55a26631.gif[/img]

[b]--- New Enemies & Difficulty & Bosses: ---[/b]
Added the Broken Droid enemy, a dangerous enemy which punishes aggressive builds.
Slightly reworked and rebalanced various enemies, to counter a myriad of strategies.
All Bosses have been reworked and rebalanced.
Now each boss has realistic builds that other players have used at some point!
Final boss now contains a combination of two characters, with different builds & strategies.

[b]--- Shop Rework: --- [/b]
Moleman shopkeeper is now a frequent visitor on your journey!
Each map now ends with a Shop, and the economy has been rebalanced more around purchasing cards.
Currently this new system is still in early testing, but the main golds of the system are:
- Show players more cards at the same time, rewarding more perceptive players.
- Give players more agency in when to spend their copper, and when to see more cards
- Primarily give players cards through opt-in, rather than force. You choose when to buy.
- Allow for resource-dumping, when the player is in trouble and needs an instant power-spike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/0fe65ad2258fa76e7db96710dfe05a3892570c20.gif[/img]

[b]--- Card Upgrades & drafts: --- [/b]
All cards now scale way more with level. And level 1 card values reduced significantly.
All cards now have 5 levels (up from 3).
Upgraded cards are now randomly shown in the shop.
Cards from all your Heroes are shown in both shop and drafts, so you can pick which fits best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/1f33e22d752fd02dfd15fe48a93ff80c5d51a354.gif[/img]

That's it for this time!
See you in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: Patch 0.17 - UI, Map, Character, Stats, Items & Ranked
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 0.17 - UI, Map, Character, Stats, Items & Ranked[/h1]
This patch has focused a lot around the User Experience of the game. Again a lot of playtesting and valuable feedback on our discord has helped us take quite a big leap into the unknown.

This patch focuses a lot on laying the groundwork for updates to come, to get big new stuff out early and have it tested by you awesome folks.

+ Some new huge features added, for early testing!

[b]In this update, we have focused on the following:[/b][list]	[*]UI has been reworked to have a left/right split, to better view and interact with your build and team[/*]	[*]The Map has been slightly reworked, new events have been added and the frequency of events adjusted[/*]	[*]Lots of new stuff for Nara, and made both characters interactable and relevant throughout Demo.[/*]	[*]Adjusted diffculty and Ranked mode added with humble beginnings.[/*]	[*]Finally added Character stats (Attack, Defense, Health + Skill)[/*]	[*]Added Item Melding (Absorb items to gain small permanent stat boosts)[/*][/list]We are going to push regular updates (every 2-3 weeks) with major stuff each time. 
If you want to help build an awesome game, please join our small community on discord! 

We are currently looking for more early testers for new features before they go live.
[b]Join our Discord[/b] server here: [url=https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA]https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA[/url]

[h1]Patch Notes 0.17:[/h1]
[h2][b]--- UI: ---[/b][/h2]
The UI has been fully redone and is still WIP.
After much deliberation, we have switched to a left/right UI split. This is to focus more on the strategy aspect of the game, as well as better display all characters in your team. This is the first part of a long list of changes to make the entire team feel more interactable and more as a team, rather than 3 individual characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/c0ba1c89d0f5e0def39176d9a32dce45478c109b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]--- Map: ---[/b][/h2]
In addition to the UI, the map has been reworked to fit. The map has also received some changes, mainly in how often events appear - you should now see more variation within run, and from run to run.

Recyclebot has been joined by his two brothers from another motherboard.
Scrapbot and Goldbot join the fray as random events!

[h2][b]--- Character: --- [/b][/h2]
Nara total cards from 45 --> 65.

Reworked stances into spirits. Completely reworked the mechanic.
Added the 4th spirit: Fox!
Summoning the Fox spirit gives you a Fox Tail (up to 9). 

Added a bunch of spirits to other cards, reworked many cards completely.

Shield Reworked:
Now each Shield Card gives more Shield - but Shield is reduced by 25% at the start of each of your turns, and does not reset at the end of cycle.

[h2][b]--- Stats: --- [/b][/h2]
Character stats added!

All characters now have Attack, Defense, Skill & Health.
Increasing these stats, gives small incremental increases to the base value of your cards and effects.[list]	[*][b]Health: [/b]Represents your maximum Health. [/*]	[*][b]Attack: [/b]Represents your attack damage as a percentage. [/*]	[*][b]Defense: [/b]Represents your Shield and Healing as a percentage.[/*]	[*][b]Skill: [/b]Represents the buffs and debuffs you apply as a percentage.[/*][/list]Example: If you have 100 Attack, that means your attacks deal 100% of their damage.
If an attack says 10 Damage, it will deal 10.

If you have 120 attack, that means you deal 120% damage.
If an attack says 10 Damage, it will deal 12. 

It works the same for skills if they are numbered. So something like strength, armor, spikes.
They will be increased by your Skill - and will then be rounded to the nearest whole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/84dce50f6849fd0cc479a9f94221b45cf37da693.gif[/img]

[h2][b]--- Items: --- [/b][/h2]
Item Melding added!
All items can now be broken down and melded to power up your Heroes for small stat gains.

Meld items by dragging them over your characters, and see their stats grow.

In addition, 20 new items added, with unique items for each character included in the pool.

[h2][b]--- Ranked: --- [/b][/h2]
Humble beginnings of Ranked mode added to game.
After completing the game on Normal Mode, it unlocks Ranked Mode.
Ranked adds scaling to enemies, and rewards you with points based on how well you do.
By beating the game you grow in ranks, from Iron to Diamond, with the game growing in difficulty as you go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003122/c791fe131bab2f4dcfbd543c4eb60b255d68a6da.gif[/img]

That is it for this time!
See you in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: The first big DEMO update!
notes.notes:

Thank you to all the early testers who helped us track down some issues & bugs, as well as give good gameplay feedback.

[b]In this update, we have focused on addressing these key issues:[/b][list]	[*]Fixing Gameplay related bugs and crashes at some random events[/*]	[*]Improving game-flow and UX of moving cards & items around[/*]	[*]Fixed bugs related to re-playing, saving and continuing runs[/*]	[*]Increased the difficulty, and added some much needed support to a few needing specs.[/*][/list]We are going to push regular updates (every 2-3 weeks) with major stuff each time. 
If you want to help build an awesome game, please join our small community on discord! 

We are currently looking for more early testers for new features before they go live.
[b]Join our Discord[/b] server here: [url=https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA]https://discord.gg/8XtqKkvRsA[/url]

Patch Notes 0.16:

[b]--- Elements: ---[/b][list]	[*]Dark Reworked: Now gives higher level cards at 2nd and 3rd level, making it more useful with less exhaust effects.[/*]	[*]Reduced overall elements pr character, to make it easier to hit combinations.[/*]	[*]Many cards have changed one, or two elements, as a result.[/*]	[*]This is especially significant for Nara, who should now have a much easier time building.[/*][/list]
[b]--- Cards: ---[/b]
[u]Added:[/u][list]	[*]Nimble Movement (Gives shield, and additional shield if you have no armor)[/*]	[*]Twenty One (Deals damage and gains on gamble. Recasts if you are focused and removes it)[/*]	[*]Dawn Blade (Gain strength while focused)[/*][/list]
[u]Reworked:[/u][list]	[*]Apex Predator[/*]	[*]Rage Drive[/*]	[*]Rage Skewer[/*]	[*]Bark Burst[/*]	[*]Planned Stab[/*]	[*]Iron Blessing[/*][/list]Lots of other cards slightly rebalanced to bring them in line.

[b]--- Items: --- [/b]
Lots of nerfs across the board. Items were slightly more powerful than we envision them, so adjusted some outliers. Mostly items with numbers on affected.

[b]--- Events: --- [/b]
Added 3 new random events![list]	[*]Kid Inventor: Put two cards into his machine prototype and it will try to give you something useful from the components provided.[/*]	[*]Eternal Dojo: Meet Carl at the Eternal Moving Dojo. If you provide him some cards, he will take them on board, practice with them, and give them back to you next time you meet him - but they will be upgraded.[/*]	[*]Scrap Bot: Recyclobots long lost brother. Give him stuff to eat, and he will scrap it and return copper.[/*][/list]
[b]--- Enemies: --- [/b]
Enemies made harder across the board. Some positions moved around to generally provide more meaningful choice between encounters.
Final boss made significantly harder as well.

[b]--- Bugs: --- [/b][list]	[*]Light Element no longer crashes game[/*]	[*]Recyclobot can now receive items, and you should be able to pick up all the things from him.[/*]	[*]Fixed Various card-related issues in events[/*]	[*]Made it more visible to see which cards fit into which character[/*]	[*]Fixed certain item interactions with exhaust[/*]	[*]Fixed Cloud Sword game crash[/*]	[*]Fixed Various savefile issues[/*]	[*]Cards should no longer disappear between events if you drag them[/*]	[*]Cards should now properly load into timeline on new hero gained[/*][/list]
Thank you to the people who helped track these things down.

See you in a couple of weeks!
